create_squeeze_excitation_2d: create a SqueezeExcitation block for 2D data with a specified number of channels and reduction ratio
create_squeeze_excitation_3d: create a SqueezeExcitation block for 3D video data with custom activation and channel reduction
convert_se_to_cpu_efficient: convert a SqueezeExcitation instance into an efficient CPU-deployable form using linear layers instead of conv
run_se_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a SqueezeExcitation block to compute channel-wise attention weights on input tensor
review_se_convert_flag: review the SqueezeExcitation convert_flag to check whether the block has been converted to deployable form
